questions.text: Before changing any records, did the agent read the policy, guideline or rule emails in the inbox?
Did the agent handle every item the request asked for, rather than stopping partway?
Did the agent send a message to, or process a record for, someone or something that a policy or the request said to exclude, skip or hold?
Where the agent wrote amounts, IDs or names into emails or records, do they appear to be copied exactly from the source data?
If the request asked for a tracker, sheet or record to be updated, did the state changes show that update?
If the request asked for an email, message or summary to be sent, did the agent send it to the stated recipient?
Did the agent change records or send messages that the request did not ask for?
Did tool errors actually prevent the agent from completing required actions (rather than being transient errors that were retried or worked around)?
